items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: You only made one record I think with him. Fuzzy Farrar was on it and Bill Rank. Fuzzy Farrar, yeah.

ctx.x: Yes. Which in particular did you most admire?
Well I liked Fuzzy Farrar, the trumpet player. He was top trumpet, five miles away from my home, at an orphanage. And he led the band down there. He played the lead and led the band and was loud.
